checks.name: node-runtime
checks.fix: The app spawns `yam serve` with a resolved Node, never with its own binary. Install Node 22 LTS or newer so that `node` is on PATH, or set YAM_NODE to the interpreter to use. Looked in: the YAM_NODE environment variable (not set); a `node` on PATH (/opt/homebrew/bin).

checks.name: accessibility
checks.detail: prompt-pending — execution error: Error: Error: Application can't be found. (-2700)
checks.fix: The Accessibility permission has not been granted to the program running Yam. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, add the terminal (or the test runner) you are running from, and switch it on. macOS asks once and remembers the answer per program, so a permission granted to Terminal does not carry to iTerm, to VS Code, or to a CI agent.

checks.name: session
checks.detail: no process in this login session owns a window (0 asked)
checks.fix: Nothing launched here will get a window, so the desktop conformance gate cannot read one and will exit 2. Unlock the display — or log in at the console rather than over SSH — and run it again.

checks.name: screen-recording
checks.detail: refused — rect (0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0) does not intersect any displays
checks.fix: Screenshots come from `screencapture`, which needs Screen Recording — a different grant from Accessibility. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording, switch it on for the program running Yam, and restart it. Without it the adapter still reads the accessibility tree; a run simply has no screenshots.
